description: This file contains mock functions for testing gateway connection behaviors using the Vitest framework. It defines mock implementations for various functions related to configuration resolution, IP address picking, host validation, and WebSocket URL validation, which are used in testing scenarios.

methods.name: resolveGatewayPortMock
methods.description: Mock function for resolving the gateway port.

methods.name: resolveStateDirMock
methods.description: Mock function to resolve the state directory, returning a default path if not specified in environment variables.

methods.name: resolveConfigPathMock
methods.description: Mock function to resolve the configuration path based on environment variables and state directory.

methods.name: pickPrimaryTailnetIPv4Mock
methods.description: Mock function to select the primary tailnet IPv4 address.

methods.name: pickPrimaryLanIPv4Mock
methods.description: Mock function to select the primary LAN IPv4 address.

methods.name: isLoopbackHostMock
methods.description: Mock function to determine if a hostname is a loopback address.

methods.name: isSecureWebSocketUrlMock
methods.description: Mock function to check if a WebSocket URL is secure, considering protocols and hostname.

ctags.name: TestMock
ctags.pattern: /^type TestMock<TArgs extends unknown[] = unknown[], TResult = unknown> = Mock<$/

ctags.name: isLoopbackHostMock
ctags.pattern: /^export const isLoopbackHostMock: TestMock<[string], boolean> = vi.fn((host: string) =>$/

ctags.name: resolveConfigPathMock
ctags.pattern: /^export const resolveConfigPathMock: TestMock<[NodeJS.ProcessEnv, string], string> = vi.fn($/
